items.summary: Site-factory disposition: preserve production and launch gates. Maintain a small readiness pipeline for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net; do not build, deploy, add domains, spend, or launch while capacity, legal, security, measurement, ownership, and rollback gates remain incomplete. Strongest candidate is complicated.work because a bounded inspection exists and it is queue-ready, but analytics, compliance, security, and owner evidence remain incomplete.
